RedTeam is construction management software built by GCs, for GCs — because we've done the job ourselves.
Commercial general contractors use RedTeam to run bids, budgets, daily logs, and documents from one place, from preconstruction through closeout. No bloated enterprise system, no six-month rollout — just software built the way GCs actually work.
